# Public Release Checklist

Before any branch is merged into this public repository:

- [ ] The change belongs to Public Present, not Private Past or Future Lab.
- [ ] No private topology, paths, repositories, connectors, agents, logs, receipts, deployment identifiers or account data are included.
- [ ] All displayed metrics come from a public-safe receipt or are clearly marked as synthetic.
- [ ] The release unit has public provenance and compatible licensing.
- [ ] Security, privacy and accessibility checks pass.
- [ ] Rollback is documented and tested for the declared scope.
- [ ] The public-information boundary workflow passes at the exact head.
- [ ] Publication approval is explicit.
